momentum_coverage.notes: missing_all_windows entries are typically thinly-traded BSE-only tickers (numeric codes) or delisted names where SWS upstream returns returns_pct: null. These stocks are still scored — computeV3Score imputes momentum at the 50th percentile and stamps breakdown.momentum_imputed: true. The gap is an upstream data limitation, not a scorer bug.
